The Buhisan-Puti-Nomolas Community Trail Loop is a 4.31 km hiking route in Buhisan, Labangon, Cebu City, that passes through communities and connects to other hiking routes and rest stops. I hiked the loop in October 2026, starting from near Buhisan Elementary School and walking to the trailhead before beginning the main route. <\/p>\n\n\n\n

The path was well-trodden, with several intersecting trails, small signs at many junctions, and sections used by local residents, children, and hikers. Along the way, I passed through shaded and exposed areas, encountered muddy and mossy sections, and came across several spots with views of the Cebu City landscape.<\/p>\n\n\n
